c0011: Temperature limits used by this sheet
c0012: ▸ Walk-in coolers and refrigerators: 32 °F to 41 °F (0 °C to 5 °C).
c0013: ▸ Freezers: 0 °F (-18 °C) or below. There is NO lower limit: a chest freezer at -15 °F or a blast freezer at -22 °F is compliant.
c0015: ▸ Hot holding (steam table): 135 °F or above (UK: 63 °C or above). There is NO upper limit: 216 °F in a steam table with simmering water is normal and not a deviation.
c0017: ▸ Recommended frequency: 2 readings a day per unit, at opening and before closing; a third one after every large load.

c0460: What FSMA 204 and the UK rules actually require
c0461: ▸ US: for foods on the Food Traceability List, FSMA 204 requires traceability records that you can hand to the FDA within 24 hours of a request. Check which of your foods are on the list and which exemptions apply to your business.
c0462: ▸ UK: "one step back, one step forward". Know who supplied each product and who you supplied it to; if you suspect that a food you have placed on the market may be unsafe, withdraw it and tell your local authority and the FSA right away.
